name: Flutter Kicks
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides, palms down.
Press your lower back down and lift both heels a few inches off the floor.
Raise one leg higher while the other stays low, knees softly bent.
Swap legs in small, steady kicks.
Lower both feet to the floor to finish.
cues: Lower back pressed to the floor
Raise heels higher if back lifts

common_mistakes.mistake: Lower back arching off the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Lift the legs higher or put hands under the hips
Keep the kicks small and even
Breathe in and out in a steady rhythm
